FL-A-0128.shortAnswer: Large Flutter apps split into packages/features with clear APIs to keep build times and ownership manageable.
FL-A-0128.answer: Answering “Design a large multi-team Flutter application so features can be developed and tested independently without creating a dependency graph that becomes impossible to maintain.?”: Large Flutter apps split into packages/features with clear APIs to keep build times and ownership manageable. One giant lib/ with circular imports slows teams and analysis. Relevant ideas: feature packages; melos/pub workspaces; public APIs; dependency rules. Extract features into packages, enforce import boundaries, and use melos for scripts. More packages help scale; over-splitting early adds friction. FL-A-0129.shortAnswer: AppLifecycleState reports resumed/inactive/paused/detached/hidden so you can pause work and save state.
FL-A-0129.answer: Answering “Design a resilient cross-platform background-sync architecture while respecting Android and iOS lifecycle/background-execution restrictions.?”: AppLifecycleState reports resumed/inactive/paused/detached/hidden so you can pause work and save state. Ignoring lifecycle wastes battery with timers/sockets in background and loses draft state. Relevant ideas: WidgetsBindingObserver; resumed vs paused; save on inactive; platform differences; BGTaskScheduler/WorkManager; constraints (network/charging). Add observer in initState, handle didChangeAppLifecycleState, remove observer on dispose. Mobile OS may kill paused apps; persist critical state to disk, don't rely on memory.
